declarations.type:
∀ (cached current : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.SemanticKey),
  SearchLoopCacheDiagnostics.diagnoseSemantic cached current = none ↔ cached = current
declarations.name: SearchLoopCacheDiagnostics.no_diagnostic_iff_exact_key

declarations.type:
∀ (cached current : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.SemanticKey) (reason : SearchLoopCacheDiagnostics.InvalidationReason),
  SearchLoopCacheDiagnostics.diagnoseSemantic cached current = some reason →
    SearchLoopCacheIdentity.decideSemanticReuse cached current = SearchLoopCacheIdentity.CacheDecision.invalidate
declarations.name: SearchLoopCacheDiagnostics.diagnostic_implies_invalidate
